summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted with worsening dyspnea, productive cough, and subjective fevers. He has multiple myeloma on bortezomib and cyclophosphamide, COPD, and a history of pneumonia. Imaging revealed findings consistent with pneumonia and COPD exacerbation, without evidence of pulmonary embolism or cardiac ischemia. He was treated with levofloxacin, transitioned to moxifloxacin, and received a steroid taper. His symptoms improved, and he was discharged home after three days. A new T8 compression fracture was identified, and he was advised to avoid lifting over five pounds. PCP prophylaxis with Bactrim was initiated due to immunosuppression. Medication adjustments included switching to metoprolol tartrate and tapering prednisone.
